title: Correct table-level data classification guidance
summary: Privacy guidance now correctly clarifies that table-level data classification is inherited by fields unless explicitly overridden, reducing false-positive guidance violations.
key_points: Table-level DataClassification is inherited by fields and does not require field-level redundant declarations
Corrected fixture and PII guidance to distinguish inherited defaults from genuinely unclassified fields
Addresses 19 false-positive privacy comments in BCApps by preventing incorrect redundant field-level declaration patterns
Verified behavior with AL 18 AppSourceCop that accepts inherited classifications
